title: A proof of the Karpelevič theorem via invariant polygons
summary: The Karpelevič theorem describes the complex numbers that occur as eigenvalues of stochastic matrices of a fixed order. We give a self-contained proof based on invariant polygons. Their geometry yields a product equation for an eigenvalue of maximal modulus at a fixed argument. Convexity determines this modulus, explicit stochastic matrices attain it, and a comparison between Farey intervals completes the boundary description.
